entry.title: Margat

terrainReference.basis: Named Qal`at al Marqab PMTiles point sets native Y=0 at 354.02029067906426 m in the retained standard viewer height grid; coarse hillside placement and reconstructed floors are approximate.

entry.note: Named PMTiles point anchors the castle and five building outlines retain native east/south positions. Foundations descend to coarse PMTiles terrain; terrace levels, outer curtains, gateway and battlement profiles are picture-led approximations. Wider northern settlement and buried/lost remains are excluded. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
